e1.flour.direction: Read the following passage aloud in the warm, unhurried cadence of a West African griot — resonant, deep, with occasional pauses for emphasis. Let the words breathe. This is oral storytelling, not news reading.
e1.flour.text: Banana flour: green bananas dried, then pounded. The gourd has travelled with her all morning.

e1.hide.text: A hide waits within reach. There is room to set down the flour before it goes between the women.

e1.witness.helped.text: Naserian turns to you. 'You helped us set it down. Here, share a little milk.'

e1.witness.quiet.text: Naserian sets the milk beside the fire. 'Stay a little. There is room for you here.'

gallery.milk.beside.text: The milk stays within reach. There is no hurry to take it.

gallery.milk.held.text: The vessel rests in your hand. The meeting has made room for you.

gallery.milk.rest.text: The milk rests beside you. Naserian reaches for something smaller.

gallery.portions.divide.text: One portion for the journey. Another to stay at home. Neither was large.

gallery.portions.enter.text: Before she left, Wambui sat with what remained. Imagine that morning with her.

gallery.portions.leave.text: She could bring less than she had promised, or leave less than she could spare.

gallery.portions.return.text: She lifted the gourd and came to speak for herself.

gallery.waiting.enter.text: Another afternoon, at this same water. This is the meeting Naserian remembers.

gallery.waiting.return.text: Now the waiting has changed hands.

gallery.waiting.short.text: That time, Naserian arrived with less than she had promised. Wambui had walked there counting on her.

gallery.waiting.stay.text: Wambui stayed. They found words for what could be given then, and what would have to wait.

gallery.where.text: We are going to what is now Kenya, before Nairobi became a city.

home.back.ember.text: The water settles into paint again. Here is the same picture, with the meeting still inside it.

home.next.text: Keep this visit if you want to return. Another part of the painting waits for you, and the same water has a story in the city of today.

home.today.ember.text: We are back before the painting. Our telling ends here. What stays with you can go further.
